info.title: Be Guided API
info.description:
Backend for the Be Guided admin, the public Ask AI widget and the "Connect your AI" MCP connector (/api/v1/mcp, JSON-RPC).

Every response uses the envelope `{ success, message, data }`; errors are `{ success: false, code, message, issues? }`.

Each operation lists its authorization policy in `x-policy`: public | authenticated | content:read | content:write | settings:manage | people:manage | publish.

Roles: viewer = content:read; editor = + content:write; owner = everything.

post.summary: MCP endpoint (JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP) for Claude and ChatGPT connectors.
post.description: "Connect your AI": a remote MCP server (Model Context Protocol, Streamable HTTP transport) for Claude custom connectors and ChatGPT. Stateless (no Mcp-Session-Id), JSON responses (no SSE), read-only, no sign-in. Send one JSON-RPC 2.0 message per POST with `Content-Type: application/json` and `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream`; after `initialize`, send `MCP-Protocol-Version`. Methods: initialize, notifications/initialized (202), ping, tools/list, tools/call. Tools: search {query}, fetch {id}, list_guides {product?, module?}. Only published, public pages of public products. Errors are JSON-RPC errors (not the API envelope): -32700 parse error, -32600 invalid request, -32601 method not found, -32602 invalid params, -32000 rate limited / too large / origin refused. A tool that fails returns a result with isError: true. CORS: requests without Origin (Claude/ChatGPT servers) are allowed; browser Origins must be on MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS. Rate limited per client address. Body ≤ 64 KB.

post.description: Stateless MCP (JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP, JSON responses). Tools: get_writing_standard, list_products, read_page, save_page, get_upload_link, upload_screenshot, request_video, request_new_product, my_changes. Keys are created by owners in the admin (Settings › Connector keys); each key is tied to one person (editor or owner) and optionally to some products. Without a valid key the answer is 401 with a JSON-RPC error.
